question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Guidance history (GAAP): Q1 FY27 7.7, Q2 8.5, Q3 9.2; each guide ~+0.8-0.9B above prior-quarter actual, actuals land ~0.08B under guide. CFO in Aug 2026: 'we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s' for FY27. On restated FY26 non-GAAP (incl SBC) 22.819B, low 50s => FY27 34.2-35.1B; YTD+Q3 guide = 24.68B, so Q4 non-GAAP ~9.55-10.46, central ~9.8-10.0; GAAP adds ~0.2 => ~10.0-10.2. Trend extrapolation (Q3 actual ~9.1 + 0.8-0.9) agrees at ~10.0. Market check: no Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi market found. Tails: acquisition-related GAAP costs (up), Q3 underrun/cost discipline (down).

- Actuals vs guide: Q1 -0.08B, Q2 -0.09B; Q4 FY26 +0.09B.

- FY27 non-GAAP actuals: Q1 7.449B, Q2 8.232B. GAAP-minus-nonGAAP gap: 0.172, 0.176, Q3 guide 0.2.
- Q2 FY27 call (Aug 26, 2026, Kress): 'For full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s driven by a broadening of our product portfolio and further increase in the usage of AI tools.' Drivers cited: compute infrastructure, comp & benefits. Measure basis (GAAP vs non-GAAP) not explicitly stated; NVIDIA customarily refers to non-GAAP.
- Arithmetic: FY26 non-GAAP 22.819 x 1.50-1.54 = 34.2-35.1B; Q1+Q2 actual + Q3 guide = 24.68B => implied Q4 non-GAAP 9.55-10.46B (sensitive to Q3 actual vs guide). On GAAP basis (23.076 x 1.50-1.54 minus 7.621+8.408+9.2) => 9.4-10.3B.
